summary: Index into locations.location for the shipment's delivery step. Required.
range: Required integer in [0, len(location)). May equal the pickup index (zero-distance leg).
businessRules: Delivery step must occur AFTER the pickup step on the same vehicle (C4).

location_index defines: Indicate the index of location for this shipment delivery. The index references the locations present in the location array. The valid range of value is \[0, length of location array). Please note …
Must stay consistent with: locations.location, shipments.pickup.location_index. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Capacity dimensions must match across jobs, shipments, and vehicles.
Numeric field; verify sign (positive/negative) and unit from spec.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: delivery index differs from pickup and is served after it.
Boundary: delivery index == pickup index (valid, zero-distance leg).
Negative-validation: delivery index == len(location) -> 400 (out of range).
Negative-validation: non-integer delivery index -> 400 type error.
Negative-infeasible: delivery window earlier than the pickup window -> precedence infeasible -> both steps unassigned.
Interaction: Negative: a job location_index equal to len(location) -> 400.
Interaction: Negative: a non-integer index like "first" -> 400 type error.
Interaction: Infeasible: delivery time window earlier than the pickup window -> precedence infeasible -> both unassigned.
Interaction: Infeasible: two amount [3] shipments onboard together on capacity [5] -> one deferred by capacity.
Interaction: Precedence: pickup [10:00,11:00], delivery [09:00,09:30] (delivery before pickup) -> both unassigned.
